deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (all Oxford courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS main round; this is the early UCAS deadline that applies to every Oxford course, Medicine and Dentistry/Veterinary. Admissions tests are sat in October (TMUA 12-16 Oct 2026 for Computer Science).

english.notes: IELTS Academic, 7.5 overall and 7.0 in each component, for all courses. Proof due by 31 July after an offer.
Only for tests taken up to 20 Jan 2026.
TOEFL tests taken from 21 Jan 2026 are not accepted; Oxford's policy is under review.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 2nd of 130 UK universities (top ~5 = S on the national scale).
